Character.Background: Discharged sapper of the Lower Docks battery

Notes.Description: Soot under the fingernails that never washes out, a burn scar along the jaw, a voice gone hoarse from shouting over cannon. Owes money to people who do not forget, and wants to be rich enough to stop flinching at knocks on the door.
Notes.Companions: Pell, a lighter boy: STR 7, lantern and club, paid 1s a day and owed for three.
Notes.Notes: Second dive under the Brassworks. The flooded gallery past the pump hall hums at night; something down there answered when we knocked. Lost 3 STR to a drowned clerk's teeth.

Arcana.name: Thrumming Lantern
Arcana.description: A brass lantern that hums when lit. Its light shows the last person who stood where it shines, as a faint shape, for a minute.

Stats.Price: Whoever holds it forgets one face each time it is lit.

Arcana.name: Stranger's Glass Eye
Arcana.description: Turns cold in the hand whenever someone nearby tells a lie.
